fact: University of Malawi's Department of Computing opened a two-day computer-skills course on 13 August 2026 for 75 female and other Malawi Police Service officers, under the UNDP-backed IDT4M programme.
Ministry of Information and Digitalisation's E-Government Director said that with partners such as the Tony Blair Institute it has provided digital skills training to over 120 civil servants.

MBC reports the Secretary to the President and Cabinet presented certificates on 7 November 2023 to 112 civil servants who completed a six-month digital skills training at the Malawi School of Government, organised by the Malawi Government with the Tony Blair Institute; about 180 enrolled.
